entities.summary: Hany Soh Hui Bin is a Singaporean politician and lawyer. A member of the governing People's Action Party (PAP), she has been the Member of Parliament (MP) representing the Woodgrove division of Marsiling–Yew Tee Group Representation Constituency since 2020.
